Ethernet support and security features are required. secure diagnostics are required. An IDPS is required, as well as a switch and possibly MacSEC encryption of the whole Ethernet LAN.

The steering system also needs to interface with supporting CAN devices, some of which may have very limited functionality, and even LIN slaves.
